[Partnered] It’s World Sandwich Day, and knows just where to celebrate! Join him at Savage in Hauz Khas, one of his favourite sandwich spots in NCR, as he digs into some delicious creations and discovers what goes into building a great sandwich.
Got a favourite of your own? Here’s to celebrating them all with FunFoods!
Har Sandwich Ka Hero. FunFoods Mayo!
